governance.description: Player-prop recommendations are sourced from explicit attributable expert analysis rather than a quantitative prop model. No recommendation may be inferred from generic player praise, fantasy rankings, team-side analysis or an unsupported projection.
governance.recommendationRule: A Recommended prop requires an explicit expert prop direction plus a stated line, threshold, or clearly attributable playable range. Multiple hosts from one show/site count as one correlated source family.
governance.priceRule: Do not invent or estimate sportsbook lines or prices. Preserve the expert's cited line/price and separately label any current executable market only when directly observed from a governed source.

confidenceTiers.A: Explicit prop recommendation with detailed mechanism plus independent confirmation or unusually strong threshold discipline.
confidenceTiers.B: Explicit attributable prop recommendation with clear mechanism and stated line/price from one high-quality source family.
confidenceTiers.Watch: Material prop discussion without enough line/price evidence to recommend a wager.
